caption: The drawing depicts a wooden furniture piece, specifically a chest or storage cabinet, positioned in three-quarter view. The chest is primarily brown, with visible wood grain texture, and features decorative orange and yellow accents in geometric patterns on its front-facing panels and drawer. The top surface is flat and rectangular, while the sides have a framed panel design. The front of the chest is divided into three main sections, with two outer panels and a central panel, all adorned with symmetrical orange geometric motifs and small square yellow accents. Below these panels is a wide horizontal drawer, decorated with additional orange and yellow geometric shapes and equipped with two small round pulls. The base of the cabinet has a scalloped edge highlighted with orange details. The background is plain and an off-white or cream color, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
